title: Driver roster
context: Ops needs the list of drivers with their city and vehicle.
task: Return name, city and vehicle_type for every driver.
answer: SELECT name, city, vehicle_type FROM drivers;

title: Completed rides only
task: Return ride_id, fare and distance_km for rides with status 'completed'.
answer: SELECT ride_id, fare, distance_km FROM rides WHERE status = 'completed';

title: Surge rides
context: Which rides were priced with surge?
task: Return ride_id, surge_multiplier and fare for rides with surge_multiplier greater than 1.
answer: SELECT ride_id, surge_multiplier, fare FROM rides WHERE surge_multiplier > 1;

title: Highly rated drivers in Bengaluru
context: A 'top driver' promo for one city.
task: Return name and rating for drivers in 'Bengaluru' with rating 4.7 or above.
answer: SELECT name, rating FROM drivers WHERE city = 'Bengaluru' AND rating >= 4.7;

title: Two-wheelers
context: Auto and Moto are the low-cost fleet.
task: Return name and vehicle_type for drivers whose vehicle_type is 'Auto' or 'Moto'.
answer: SELECT name, vehicle_type FROM drivers WHERE vehicle_type IN ('Auto','Moto');

title: All cancellations
task: Return ride_id and status for rides whose status is not 'completed'.
answer: SELECT ride_id, status FROM rides WHERE status <> 'completed';

title: Mid-distance rides
task: Return ride_id and distance_km for rides with distance between 5 and 10 km inclusive.
answer: SELECT ride_id, distance_km FROM rides WHERE distance_km BETWEEN 5 AND 10;

title: Morning pickups
context: Rides picked up during the 08:xx hour.
task: Return ride_id and pickup_time where pickup_time starts with '08:'.
answer: SELECT ride_id, pickup_time FROM rides WHERE pickup_time LIKE '08:%';

title: Rides with no duration
context: Cancelled rides have no duration recorded.
task: Return ride_id and status where duration_min IS NULL.
answer: SELECT ride_id, status FROM rides WHERE duration_min IS NULL;

title: Longest trips
task: Return ride_id and distance_km for the 5 longest rides (ties by ride_id).
answer: SELECT ride_id, distance_km FROM rides ORDER BY distance_km DESC, ride_id LIMIT 5;

title: Newest drivers
context: Recently onboarded drivers get a check-in call.
task: Return name and join_date for the 3 most recently joined drivers.
answer: SELECT name, join_date FROM drivers ORDER BY join_date DESC LIMIT 3;

title: Fare per km
task: Return ride_id and fare_per_km = fare / distance_km rounded to 2 decimals, for completed rides with distance_km > 0.
answer: SELECT ride_id, ROUND(fare / distance_km, 2) AS fare_per_km FROM rides WHERE status = 'completed' AND distance_km > 0;

title: Driver earnings per ride
task: Return ride_id and driver_take = fare * 0.75 rounded to 2 decimals for completed rides.
answer: SELECT ride_id, ROUND(fare * 0.75, 2) AS driver_take FROM rides WHERE status = 'completed';

title: Average speed
task: Return ride_id and speed_kmh = distance_km / (duration_min / 60.0) rounded to 1 decimal for completed rides with duration_min > 0.
answer: SELECT ride_id, ROUND(distance_km / (duration_min / 60.0), 1) AS speed_kmh FROM rides WHERE status = 'completed' AND duration_min > 0;

title: Pickup hour
context: Extract the hour from pickup_time text.
task: Return ride_id and pickup_hour = the hour as an integer from pickup_time ('HH:MM').
answer: SELECT ride_id, CAST(SUBSTR(pickup_time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) AS pickup_hour FROM rides;

title: Driver first names
task: Return driver_id and first_name = the text before the first space in name.
answer: SELECT driver_id, SUBSTR(name, 1, INSTR(name, ' ') - 1) AS first_name FROM drivers;

title: Rides per status
context: The funnel: completed vs cancelled vs no-show.
task: Return status and rides count for each status.
answer: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS rides FROM rides GROUP BY status;

title: Active riders
context: How many riders have taken at least one ride?
task: Return active_riders = COUNT(DISTINCT rider_id) from rides.
answer: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rider_id) AS active_riders FROM rides;

title: Gross bookings
task: Return gross_bookings = SUM(fare) for completed rides, 2 decimals.
answer: SELECT ROUND(SUM(fare), 2) AS gross_bookings FROM rides WHERE status = 'completed';

title: Average fare and distance
task: Return avg_fare and avg_km (both 2 decimals) over completed rides.
answer: SELECT ROUND(AVG(fare), 2) AS avg_fare, ROUND(AVG(distance_km), 2) AS avg_km FROM rides WHERE status = 'completed';

title: Average driver rating per city
task: Return city and avg_rating (2 decimals) from drivers grouped by city.
answer: SELECT city, ROUND(AVG(rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM drivers GROUP BY city;

title: Fare extremes
task: Return min_fare and max_fare among completed rides.
answer: SELECT MIN(fare) AS min_fare, MAX(fare) AS max_fare FROM rides WHERE status = 'completed';

title: Drivers per vehicle type
task: Return vehicle_type and drivers count.
answer: SELECT vehicle_type, COUNT(*) AS drivers FROM drivers GROUP BY vehicle_type;

title: Riders per city
task: Return city and riders count from riders.
answer: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS riders FROM riders GROUP BY city;

title: Bookings per driver
task: Return driver_id and bookings = SUM(fare) over completed rides, 2 decimals.
answer: SELECT driver_id, ROUND(SUM(fare), 2) AS bookings FROM rides WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY driver_id;

title: Hours online per driver
task: Return driver_id and hours = SUM(hours_online) from driver_shifts, 1 decimal.
answer: SELECT driver_id, ROUND(SUM(hours_online), 1) AS hours FROM driver_shifts GROUP BY driver_id;

title: Busiest pickup hours
task: Return pickup_hour (integer) and rides count, ordered by rides descending then hour, top 5.
answer: SELECT CAST(SUBSTR(pickup_time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) AS pickup_hour, COUNT(*) AS rides FROM rides GROUP BY pickup_hour ORDER BY rides DESC, pickup_hour LIMIT 5;

title: Frequent riders
task: Return rider_id and rides count for riders with more than 10 rides (any status).
answer: SELECT rider_id, COUNT(*) AS rides FROM rides GROUP BY rider_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 10;

title: Ride with driver name
task: Return ride_id, driver name (as driver) and fare for every ride.
answer: SELECT r.ride_id, d.name AS driver, r.fare FROM rides r JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id = r.driver_id;

title: Premier rides
task: Return ride_id and fare for completed rides whose driver's vehicle_type is 'Premier'.
hint: Join drivers, filter vehicle_type and status.
answer: SELECT r.ride_id, r.fare FROM rides r JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id = r.driver_id WHERE d.vehicle_type = 'Premier' AND r.status = 'completed';

title: Bookings per city
task: Return city and bookings = SUM(fare) over completed rides, 2 decimals.
answer: SELECT d.city, ROUND(SUM(r.fare), 2) AS bookings FROM rides r JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id = r.driver_id WHERE r.status = 'completed' GROUP BY d.city;

title: Tips per driver
task: Return driver_id and tips = SUM(tip) from ride_ratings joined to rides, per driver.
answer: SELECT r.driver_id, SUM(rr.tip) AS tips FROM ride_ratings rr JOIN rides r ON r.ride_id = rr.ride_id GROUP BY r.driver_id;

title: Distance band
task: Return ride_id and band: 'Long' if distance_km >= 15, 'Medium' if >= 5, else 'Short'.
answer: SELECT ride_id, CASE WHEN distance_km >= 15 THEN 'Long' WHEN distance_km >= 5 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Short' END AS band FROM rides;

title: Rides per month
task: Return month (YYYY-MM) and rides count, ordered by month.
answer: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', ride_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS rides FROM rides GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;
